ON NOVEMBER 11, 2026, TITLED "POLYPID PROVIDES CORPORATE UPDATE AND REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS." Exhibit 99.1 PolyPid Provides Corporate Update and Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results D-PLEX₁₀₀ NDA Under FDA Priority Review with PDUFA Goal Date of November 28, 2026; U.S.

Launch: ● The FDA is reviewing the New Drug Application (“NDA”) for D-PLEX₁₀₀ for the prevention of surgical site infections (“SSIs”) in patients undergoing colorectal surgery under Priority Review, with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) goal date of November 28, 2026.

Labeling discussions with the FDA are underway, and all scheduled FDA interactions are on track and aligned with the PDUFA goal date. ● Subject to approval, PolyPid and Azurity Pharmaceuticals (“Azurity”) are preparing for the U.S. commercial launch of D-PLEX₁₀₀ in early 2027.
“With our PDUFA goal date fast approaching, this is a defining moment for PolyPid,” said Dikla Czaczkes Akselbrad, Chief Executive Officer of PolyPid.

We are now focused on executing our PolyPid 2030 plan, and we look forward to sharing our progress.” Upcoming Expected Milestones: ● PDUFA goal date for the D-PLEX₁₀₀ NDA of November 28, 2026. ● Initiation of FDA communications on label expansion of D-PLEX₁₀₀ into broader abdominal surgery in the fourth quarter of 2026. ● Potential U.S. commercial launch of D-PLEX₁₀₀ by Azurity in early 2027. ● New Drug Submission for D-PLEX₁₀₀ in Canada in 2027. ● CMS decision on NTAP for D-PLEX₁₀₀ in August 2027. ● EMA decision on the D-PLEX₁₀₀ MAA in the second half of 2027. ● PD01B pre-Investigational New Drug (“IND”) meeting with the FDA and first-in-human study, both expected in the second half of 2027. 2 Financial Results for the Three Months Ended September 30, 2026 ● Research and development expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026, were $6.5 million, compared to $5.3 million in the same three-month period of 2025.

The decrease was primarily due to the decrease of non-cash expenses related to performance-based options following the positive Phase 3 SHIELD II topline results, which triggered the vesting of those options. ● Marketing and business development expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026, were $0.4 million, compared to $0.4 million for the same period of 2025. ● Other income for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was $2.5 million, reflecting the recognition of previously deferred revenue following the termination of the ADVANZ agreement on September 30, 2026. ● For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Company had a net loss of $5.8 million, or $(0.24) per share, compared to a net loss of $7.5 million, or $(0.37) per share, in the three-month period ended September 30, 2025.
